Sebastien Bubeck / @sebastienbubeck :

OpenAI's Sébastien Bubeck says he never asked for removal of Levent Alpöge from authorship of the work Alpöge and Tristan Buckmaster did on Navier-Stokes   —  I would like to clarify a few things: 1) The screenshot is my reaching out to Levent to coordinate our releases.
